title: Export invoices as CSV
summary: Let users export their invoices as CSV, reusing the existing Report Builder.

provenance.statement: Let users export their invoices as CSV. It must reuse the existing Report Builder and finish in under 10 seconds for 10,000 rows.

ambiguities.question: Who counts as 'users' (all authenticated users, only account owners, admins, or specific roles), and may a user export only their own invoices or all invoices they can view?
Which invoice fields and which CSV conventions (columns, headers, delimiter, encoding, date and currency formats) should the export use?
Can users filter or select which invoices to export (date range, status, customer), or is the export always the full set?
Where is the export triggered and delivered (UI button, API endpoint, file download, emailed link)?

What are the conditions of the 10-second target for 10,000 rows (hardware, concurrent load, measurement point such as server-side generation versus end-to-end download), and what behavior is expected beyond 10,000 rows?
What does 'reuse the existing Report Builder' require: must the export run entirely through its existing interface, and may the Report Builder be extended if it lacks CSV output?

acceptance_criteria.statement: Users can export their invoices as a CSV file.
The export reuses the existing Report Builder.
The export finishes in under 10 seconds for 10,000 rows.

revision_history.note: Initial translation of the stated request; not yet reviewed.
